A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the laboratory diagnostic followup of an epidemiologic study concerning the heart and vessels is to be carried out by a few, but reliable laboratory parameters.
a reduction in the number of examinations can be achieved in laboratory studies without any loss of diagnostic information.

the laboratory parameters of total protein, serum electrophorese, zinc-sulpha test, hematocit and hemoglobin are redundant in the follow-up examination under the suspicion of heart and vascular diseases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the laboratory diagnostic should be adapted to the clinical and epidemiological requirements of the individual problem.
it is not possible to draw any conclusions from the laboratory data concerning heart and vessel disease in the absence of the x-ray data.
it is possible to reduce the laboratory load in the follow-up examinations by means of the laboratory diagnostic follow up program of epidemiological cardiovascular studies.
